fields.label: Server Type
fields.description: Gateway Server or Ingress Server — the two planes take different pushes, and a row says which one this was.

fields.label: Reachable
fields.description: Whether the proxy's admin API was reachable at all (no connection error / timeout).

fields.label: Success
fields.description: Whether the requested keys and/or routes pushes returned 2xx.

fields.label: Had Data
fields.description: Usage pulls: whether this proxy had any staged usage to drain (0 = nothing accrued since last pull).

fields.label: Detail
fields.description: What was pushed, e.g. keys:3 routes:1
